RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE.

According to D.S.I. Umemoto, the Japanese
Gendarmerie could not produce any evidence to substantiate
the charge against the two arrested young men, in view
of which, I would respectfully suggest that the men be
set free immediately.

D.S.I. Umemoto requests that the men be released
upon guarantee, in case they would be again wanted by
the Japanese Gendarmerie for further questioning.

The men were questioned and emphatically denied
having been members of the Mobile Unit or being engaged
in any anti-Japanese activities.

Their statements have been taken down and are
attached herewith.

〔签名〕
D.S.I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of LOH WEN KWE (罗文奎).
native of WANGDO taken by me C.D.S. 115.
at C.B.H.Q.C.1. on the 4.10.38. and interpreted by Hsu.

My name is Loh Wen Kwe, age 19, native of Wangdo,
S/Unemployed, but formerly employed as an accountant at
the Yue Dah Sauce Shop, Ying Ziang Kiang village, and
residing at No. 44, Lane No. 166 Taku Road, (the home of
my uncle, named Loh Shing Dee).

During the outbreak of the Shanghai hostilities on
13.8.37, I evacuated to live in my native place (Wangdo),
where I remained until the month of December 1937, when
I came back to Shanghai, but I later returned there again.

Between December 1937 and September this year I travelled
to and from Shanghai and Wangdo for about five times, for
the sole purpose of visiting my parents in the above said
city. Besides I had no other particular work done in Wangdo.

Owing to my recent illness I removed to live in Room
210 Yangtsze Hotel, Hankow Road, which was engaged by one
of my friends, named Wong Kung Chah. During my stay in
the above mentioned room I received from a friend, one named Zee
Pou Dah Dah a marriage invitation card, bearing the time
date and place of his marriage.

I, therefore, at about 8 p.m. on 4.10.38, accompanied
by my friend, Wong Kung Chah, proceeded to the China Hotel,
Kweichow Road. We were partaking of the wedding feast when
the Police raided and placed me under arrest. The reason
for my arrest is unknown to me.

I have never served in any military, police or volunteer
force. This is my true statement.

SIGNED : LOH WEN KWE .

警方调查报告。

以下为罗文奎（LOH WEN KWE）的供词，籍贯王渡（Wangdo），由本人（刑事侦探警员 115号）于1938年10月4日在刑事科总部C.1室录取，由徐氏翻译。

我叫罗文奎，19岁，籍贯王渡，目前无业，但此前曾在应象江村（Ying Ziang Kiang village）的悦大酱园担任会计，现居住在大沽路166弄44号（即我叔叔罗星迪 Loh Shing Dee 的家）。

1937年8月13日上海战事爆发期间，我撤离至家乡（王渡）居住，一直住到1937年12月，当时我回到上海，但后来又返回家乡。

从1937年12月到今年9月期间，我往返于上海和王渡约五次，唯一目的是探望在上述城市的父母。此外，我在王渡没有其他特定工作。

由于最近生病，我搬至汉口路扬子饭店210房间居住，该房间由我的一位朋友黄公查（Wong Kung Chah，音译）租用。在上述房间居住期间，我从一位名叫谢宝达（Zee Pou Dah Dah，音译）的朋友那里收到一张结婚请柬，上面注明了他婚礼的时间、日期和地点。

因此，在1938年10月4日晚上8点左右，我在朋友黄公查的陪同下，前往贵州路的中国饭店。我们正在参加婚宴时，警察突袭并将我逮捕。我被捕的原因我不清楚。

我从未在任何军队、警察或志愿部队服役。这是我的真实供词。

签名：罗文奎。

FORM 40
G. 30M-4-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of SUNG NYIEN (陈新干), 23, 215 China Hotel
native of Puer Loong Village, taken by me D.S.I. Soong Ping Tsang,
at C.I. on the 5. 10. 38 and interpreted by Yao.

My name is SUNG NYIEN, aged 23 years, and native of Puen
Loong Village, near Tsing-pu. I am now staying in Room No. 215,
China Hotel. I am employed as an accountant in the Maintenance
Society of that Village, receiving a salary of $20.00 per month.
The chairman of this society is HUANG PEH ZU, who is also a native
of that village.

On 2.10.38 I came to Shanghai for the purpose of (1) taking
my sister back to country, where it has now become peaceful to
settle down, and (2) to tender my congratulations to my friend
Mr. Zee Paung Dah on the occasion of his wedding on the 4.10.38.

On the 4.10.38 the wedding ceremony was held at the China
Hotel, and I was invited to attend the party amongst his other
friends and relatives. Besides, Mr. Zee requested me to assist
him in keeping other guests entertained on that day in the
wedding hall.

At about 6 p.m. I and other guests sat together at the
wedding dinner. We were just dining when the Police Party
arrived and placed all of us under arrest.

At the party, I know the bride-groom, Mr. Zee only. He
is a member of the Yang Kyi Steam-ship Co. whose vessels used to
pass the area, which is under the control of our Maintenance
Society. This is how I knew him. I know nobody else at the party.

I have never been in military, police or volunteer service.

This is the truth.

SUNG NYIEN.
page_data.zh:
表格 40
G. 30M-4-38

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

警方调查报告。

以下为陈新干（SUNG NYIEN，原文如此，中文名疑为音译差异）的供词，23岁，住中国饭店215室，籍贯浦龙村（Puer Loong Village），由本人高级警督宋炳昌（Soong Ping Tsang）于1938年10月5日在刑事科录取，由姚氏翻译。

我叫陈新干（SUNG NYIEN），23岁，籍贯青浦附近的浦龙村（Puen Loong Village）。我现在住在中国饭店215室。我在该村的维持会担任会计，月薪20元。该维持会主席是黄佩祖（HUANG PEH ZU，音译），他也是该村人。

1938年10月2日，我来上海的目的是：(1) 带我的妹妹回乡下，那里现在已恢复平静，可以安居；(2) 祝贺我的朋友谢宝达先生（Mr. Zee Paung Dah，音译）于1938年10月4日举行婚礼。

1938年10月4日，婚礼在中国饭店举行，我受邀与其他亲友一同参加聚会。此外，谢先生请求我在当天协助他在宴会厅招待其他客人。

下午6点左右，我和其他客人一起入席参加婚宴。我们正在用餐时，警察队伍到达并将我们所有人逮捕。

在聚会上，我只认识新郎谢先生。他是杨记轮船公司（Yang Kyi Steam-ship Co.）的成员，该公司的船只经常经过我们要维持会控制的区域。这就是我认识他的原因。聚会上其他人我都不认识。

我从未在军队、警察或志愿部队服役。

属实。

陈新干（SUNG NYIEN）。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE.

On the afternoon of October 4th. 1938, D.S.I. Umemoto of the Special Political Office, requested the assistance, on behalf of Sergeant HIRANO of the Japanese Gendarmerie, in effecting the arrest of a number of bandits, operating in Wong-doo Area, Kading District), who would assemble that night at the China Hotel, 160 Kweichow Road.

Upon instructions from D.I. Glover, assistance was rendered by D.S.I. Konovaloff, D.S.I. Soong Ping Tsung and the undersigned.

At 8 p.m. a party of police in company of D.S. I. Umemoto, Sergeant Hirano and a number of Japanese Gendarmes visited the China Hotel, where the following persons were apprehended : -

1) TSANG SE TSOONG (張思忠), 30, Shanghai, shipping clerk, Taku Road.
2) SUNG KING ZIANG (沈賡祥), 27, Pootung, Clerk, S'hai Race Club, Mohawk Road.
3) SUNG KING YUEH (沈賡悅), 20, Pootung, Shipping Clerk, Yung Kyi Shipping Co
4) SUNG TSUNG DAU (沈春濤), 23, Pootung, Shipping Clerk, Yung Kyi Shipping Co
5) ZAU DEE KUNG (趙禮耕), 27, Hunan, Clerk, Hung Kwan Co.16 Ave.Rd.VII.

协助日本宪兵队。

1938年10月4日下午，特别政治办公室的高级警督梅本（Umemoto）代表日本宪兵队平野（HIRANO）军曹请求协助，逮捕一批在嘉定区王渡地区活动的匪徒，据悉他们将于当晚在贵州路160号的中国饭店集合。

根据警司格洛弗（Glover）的指示，高级警督科诺瓦洛夫（Konovaloff）、高级警督宋炳昌（Soong Ping Tsung）及本人提供了协助。

晚上8点，一队警察在高级警督梅本、平野军曹和数名日本宪兵的陪同下前往中国饭店，在那里逮捕了以下人员：-

1) 张思忠（TSANG SE TSOONG），30岁，上海人，航运职员，住大沽路。
2) 沈赓祥（SUNG KING ZIANG），27岁，浦东人，上海跑马总会职员，住莫霍克路（Mohawk Road，即今黄陂北路一带）。
3) 沈赓悦（SUNG KING YUEH），20岁，浦东人，永记轮船公司航运职员。
4) 沈春涛（SUNG TSUNG DAU），23岁，浦东人，永记轮船公司航运职员。
5) 赵礼耕（ZAU DEE KUNG），27岁，湖南人，宏宽公司（Hung Kwan Co.）职员，住爱文义路16号（16 Ave.Rd.VII）。
